verdict: FAIL_SOURCE_GATE. M1970 fixes all three functional/liveness defects called out by M1967: it drives each descriptor on negedge, independently latches base and TSBG acceptance while keeping the shared payload immutable, arms a 100000-cycle whole-test watchdog before any task, and explicitly disables both named join_any completion forks. The unchanged directed workload, attacks, ledgers, unique PASS token, RTL, adapter, SVA, and docs/359 identities are preserved. However, M1965 made complete phase tokens and a parseable per-load timeout dump mandatory before any fresh runner. M1970 still emits only four load-phase tokens and its timeout fatal omits phase, each side's valid/accept/pending fields, and a distinct M1970_LOAD_TIMEOUT token. Those are fail-closed observability requirements, so no runner or EDA attempt is authorized.

watchdog_and_fork_audit.whole_test_bound_static_safety_assessmen: PASS_FOR_EXPECTED_DIRECTED_WORKLOAD. The full phase contains 48 descriptors, 576 baseline bundle beats, and 144 TSBG bundle beats; the recovery phase contains 4 descriptors and 12 beats per side. The directed memory model has at most one cyclic request-ready bubble and response delay no greater than eight clocks per beat, while bridge/commit periodic stalls are isolated single-cycle bubbles. Even a deliberately loose serialized 100 clocks per baseline beat is 57600 clocks before recovery and fixed control overhead, below 100000. This is not a VCS runtime measurement.

m1965_m1967_compliance.complete_phase_tokens: FAIL: only full_load_begin/full_load_complete/recovery_load_begin/recovery_load_complete are emitted; reset, full_execute, replay_attack, stale_attack, recovery_execute, and final_checks BEGIN/END tokens required by M1965 remain absent
m1965_m1967_compliance.timeout_state_dump: FAIL: context/group/base_seen/tsbg_seen/ready/busy/fault/cycle are present, but phase, each valid, each accept, and explicit pending fields required by M1965 are absent

p1_findings: P1-1: M1970 still emits only four load-phase tokens. M1965 explicitly requires unique BEGIN and END tokens for reset, full load, full execute, replay attack, stale attack, recovery load, recovery execute, and final checks. Without these tokens a runner cannot prove every intended phase executed before the unique PASS.

P1-2: the per-load timeout is bounded but not runner-grade fail-closed telemetry. It lacks a distinct M1970_LOAD_TIMEOUT token and omits phase, base/TSBG valid, base/TSBG accept, and explicit pending state. M1965 required those fields before authorizing a fresh runner.

Include phase, context, group, load_last, base_valid, tsbg_valid, base_ready, tsbg_ready, base_accept, tsbg_accept, base_pending, tsbg_pending, base_busy, tsbg_busy, base_protocol_error, tsbg_protocol_error, and tb_cycle.
